stem: Incoming clones have correct cultivar labels but incomplete source-health documentation. What is the best systems response?
choices: Keep them in the controlled intake/quarantine process until required evidence and inspection criteria are satisfied
Release them because identity is known
Place them beside established mothers for comparison
Discard all source records and begin a new lot
rationale: Identity alone does not establish biosecurity status. Intake controls should verify health and source evidence before release into established production.
